info.title: PenPal API
info.description: AI-assisted security assessment platform. Human verification is mandatory: AI output is advisory and only assessor-confirmed findings appear in reports.

get.description: Returns OK when the API process is running.
Checks the database, ZAP daemon, Nmap binary and AI configuration. Never returns secret values.

post.summary: Log in and receive a JWT access token

patch.summary: Update role, active state, name or password (admin only)

post.description: Registers a target and its authorization reference. The assessment starts as a draft; scans stay blocked until authorization is confirmed.

post.summary: Record that the assessor confirmed authorization
post.description: Sets the confirmation flag, user and timestamp. Required before any scan. The authorization reference must already be recorded.

post.summary: Archive an assessment (no further scans or scope edits)
Add an in-scope or out-of-scope rule
post.description: Values are canonicalised. Host rules are exact unless written as '*.example.test'. CIDR rules are normalised to the network address.

schema.title: Response List Scope Items Api V1 Assessments  Assessment Id  Scope Items Get

post.description: Returns the verdict and specific reasons without starting a scan. The check is audited. Out-of-scope rules beat in-scope rules, DNS is resolved, and public addresses are rejected by default.

post.summary: Request an Nmap or ZAP scan
post.description: Validates the profile, target and ports, re-runs the scope guard, stores a queued scan and returns immediately. Only one scan per assessment may be queued or running at a time. Target reachability is checked again when the job starts.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running scan
post.description: Marks the scan cancelled immediately and asks the running tool to stop. A completed or failed scan cannot be cancelled.

200.description: Raw Nmap XML or ZAP JSON

404.description: Scan or raw output not found

409.description: The scan has not produced raw output

get.summary: Aggregated hosts, ports and services from completed Nmap scans
get.description: Parses stored Nmap XML and merges observations by host address. Open observations win over closed ones. A scan whose raw file is missing or unparseable is reported in its scan entry with a parse_error.

get.summary: List findings with filters and sorting
get.description: Severity filters and sorting use the effective severity: final severity for confirmed findings, otherwise AI-suggested severity, otherwise tool severity.

post.description: Manual findings start pending, are attributed to the assessor, and never set final severity or verification state.

patch.description: False positives need a reason of at least 10 characters. Confirmed findings need a final severity or fall back to AI/tool severity with an audit note. AI output can never set these fields.

post.summary: Add a note or upload evidence for a finding
post.description: Send either a note or one file (png, jpg, jpeg, txt, pdf). Files are size-limited, checked against their extension and MIME type, stored under a random name, and hashed.

schema.title: Response List Evidence Api V1 Findings  Finding Id  Evidence Get

post.summary: Run interpretation and remediation for one finding
post.description: Runs both advisory AI functions on redacted evidence. AI output never sets the final severity or verification state. Provider failures are stored per function and do not fail the request.

post.summary: Queue bulk analysis for an assessment
post.description: Queues a background job over matching findings. Progress is available at GET /assessments/{id}/ai-status. Only one bulk job runs per assessment.

get.summary: List AI analyses for a finding
get.description: Returns every attempt newest first, including the exact sanitized input that was sent and its redaction report.

schema.title: Response List Analyses Api V1 Findings  Finding Id  Ai Analyses Get

get.description: Severity counts use final severity for confirmed findings and AI-suggested or tool severity otherwise. Includes verification, category, scan and AI coverage data without per-finding queries.
Newest first. Audit rows are append-only and never updated or deleted.

post.summary: Generate an HTML or PDF assessment report
post.description: Builds the report from assessor-confirmed findings only. If PDF rendering fails, a ready HTML report is returned instead and the report row records why.

min_severity.description: Only analyze findings at or above this severity.

only_unanalyzed.title: Only Unanalyzed
only_unanalyzed.description: Skip findings that already have a successful interpretation.

severity_basis.title: Severity Basis
severity_basis.description: Confirmed findings use final severity; other findings use AI-suggested severity when present, otherwise tool severity.
severity_basis.default: Confirmed findings use final severity; other findings use AI-suggested severity when present, otherwise tool severity.

example.description: A negative quantity increases store credit.
example.title: Business logic bypass in checkout

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Nmap: quick, standard, full_tcp. ZAP: baseline, active_limited.

target.title: Target
target.description: Host or IP for Nmap; absolute http(s) URL for ZAP.

ports.title: Ports
ports.description: Optional Nmap ports. Empty uses the profile's default port set.

tags.name: Scope
tags.description: In-scope and out-of-scope rules; dry-run checks
